description: Unique identifier - identical to sample name
Coded sample name - unique identifier
Organism sampled
Host Plant - in this case all 309 samples are lettuce
Type of lettuce - in this case all 309 samples are outredgeous (red romaine)
Genotype - Wild Type (not GMO)
Part of lettuce sampled (root, shoot, or irrigation water)
References growth time of the plant at time sample was taken (0 days, 7 days, 14 days, 28 days)
Unit related to Factor Value[Growth Time] - measured in days in this study
References how many ppb of ionic silver the sample was given (also corresponds to treatment group): 0 ppb (control), 31 ppb (Group 1), 125 ppb (Group 2), 500 ppb (Group 3)
Unit related to Factor Value[Treatment] - measured in parts per billion (ppb)
References growth medium of plant, rockwool cube (hydroponic system) or amended autoclaved arcillite (clay-based growth medium)
References where study took place - Earth Surface
References growth temp of sample env - always set to 25 degrees C to mimic ISS conditions
Unit related to Parameter Value[Mean Growth Temperature] - always set to degrees Celsius
References type of container plant was housed in - square plastic pots (9 cm tall, 10.2 cm width) for arcillite system, and not applicable for hydroponic setup
References number of seeds per container - 4 for arcillite pots, 2 for hydroponic rockwool cubes
References type of light source used in environment - Light Emitting Diode Device to mimic ISS conditions
References light intensity - always set to 300 micromole per square meter per second to mimic ISS conditions
Unit related to Parameter Value[Light Intensity] - always set to micromole per square meter per second
References light cycle used during experiment - 16:8 hours of light followed by 8 hours of dark (16:8 light:dark)
Unit related to Parameter Value[light cycle] - always set to hour
References hardware setup used - either Nutrient Film Technique (NFT) hydroponic system or NA for arcillite-based samples
References age of sample at harvest - 0, 7, 14, 21, or 28 days
Unit related to Parameter Value[Age at sample harvest] - always days
References how samples were preserved - all were preserved in Liquid Nitrogen
References what temperature preserved samples were stored at - always set to -80 degrees Celsius (-80)
Unit related to Parameter Value[Sample Storage Temperature] - always set to degrees Celsius
